Five islands. One New Year's to remember.

Adults only, round trip from San Juan. Here's where we're headed. 🌴

  • St. Maarten
  • Barbados
  • Martinique
  • Antigua
  • St. Thomas

A quick heads-up about travel

We sail the evening of December 26, so plan to fly into San Juan on Christmas Day or a day or two before. Flying the morning of the 26th is too risky if a flight gets delayed. 🎄

Airfare is not included. Each traveler books and manages their own flights to and from San Juan.

Why I'm putting this together

A lot of you told me the same thing. You want longer trips. Better destinations. And time to enjoy the vacation without being rushed.

You also want time to plan and pay. That's why I'm starting now. Over a year out means smaller, comfortable payments and nothing hanging over you when it's time to go.

This form doesn't book anything or ask for money. It just helps me build the right trip for the people who actually want to go.

Sabrina 💛
